last_session.text: The party reached Brandonsford at sunset, following a treasure map to places they did not recognize.
Reginald the frog warned the party to avoid a trickster Clurichen that comes into town each night.
Eric the Reeve offered a bounty for the dragon that tore off woodsman George's arm. Sir Phidipaldi then challenged Eric to a duel, which Eric declined.
Lady Hilda, a seasoned warrior at the Clumsy Fox, offered to hunt the dragon with the party for pay.
Dr. Uriah shared drinks with Drop Dead Ned, a thief with a killer wasp who offered his services.
Bentley and Farmer Gill said supplies have stopped reaching Brandonsford, leaving the smith with almost nothing to sell.
Dunk drank from Farmer Gill's still on the porch, keeping Gill talking about his trinkets until he wobbled.
Golden Egg owner Quinn hired Sir Phidipaldi to catch whoever empties his bar each night.

open.text: Find the treasure on the party's map.
Kill the black dragon near Brandonsford and drag its body into town for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Find out who empties Quinn's bar at the Golden Egg each night and collect his 100 gold.
If Sir Phidipaldi makes a big show of delivering Quinn's water-filled bottles, they may see who comes for the stock.
If the party returns to the Clumsy Fox and pays Lady Hilda, she will join their dragon hunt.
If the party pays Drop Dead Ned 100 gold a week, he and his killer wasp will do anything that lets him kill. He refunds 5 gold per allowed kill if he can do what he wants with the bodies.
Who or what empties Quinn's bar each night?
Why does Warwick the smith keep adding lucky charms to his shop?
What is stopping shipments from reaching Brandonsford?
What does the Clurichen do when it comes into town each night?
